patthana14.16:1.1: āsavañceva sāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavo ceva na anāsavo ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, āsavañceva sāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na anāsavo ceva na no ca āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, āsavañceva sāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavo ceva na anāsavo ca na anāsavo ceva na no ca āsavo dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā,
patthana14.16:2.1: sāsavañceva no ca āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anāsavo ceva na no ca āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana14.16:3.1: āsavañceva sāsavañce sāsavañceva no ca āsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavo ceva na anāsavo ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
